_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of the Lord.
We come with our whole hearts to learn.
Eat this bread, drink this cup, and abide in me.
And we will abide in him, and he in us.
Be filled with the Spirit; sing and make melody.
We come singing, with thanks in our hearts.
Come, all who hunger for life; come, let us worship.
We come to the table of the Lord. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Wisdom begins in awe, said the old psalm, and Solomon asked God not for riches but for a listening heart to know the good.
Give us this bread always.
The living bread is no mere idea: take and eat, take and drink, and the life of God runs in you the way blood runs in your veins.
Give us this bread always.
Those who eat this bread abide in Christ and Christ in them, at home in one another, the way a branch lives in the vine.
Give us this bread always.
So be filled, and sing; come to the table set for the hungry, and let your whole heart make melody to God.
Give us this bread always.
